arxiv.title: What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions
arxiv.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.
arxiv.titleZh: 什么让提问具有好奇心？测量人-LLM 交互中的模型好奇心
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出「模型好奇心」概念，指为揭示知识空白、隐含假设与替代方案而主动发起的认识论式提问，并给出理论支撑的分类体系，用以区分好奇心驱动的问题与普通模型提问。在四个对话数据集上统计发现，此类问题仅占全部提问的17–28%，但与用户随后更具探索性、信息更丰富的回应相关，且各数据集模式存在差异。人类评估显示，好奇心提问在建议、创意与研究场景中更能促进用户探索。为设计更有选择性地提问、支持深度探索与人机协作的 LLM 提供依据。
arxiv.reason: LLM 提问行为的测量与分类研究，偏评测方法学，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.
arxiv.comment: 36 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23586834
arxiv.titleZh: 为什么结构化输出会失败?跨九个 LLM 的提示强制 Pydantic schema 实证研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对在提示中指定 Pydantic schema、校验失败即重试的托管模型流水线，提出细粒度的 schema 一致性失败分类法与确定性分类器，依据模型响应与 Pydantic 校验错误自动归类失败原因。在 HotpotQA 与 FinanceBench 上覆盖 9 种 OpenAI/Anthropic 模型与 API 配置共 3997 次生成，发现相近的有效率可能掩盖完全不同的失败构成;Markdown 围栏 JSON 是最常见失败，681 次围栏失败中仅 48.0% 在去除围栏后通过校验，其余仍隐藏字段长度等违规。提示消融显示抑制围栏只是让既有违规暴露，而非引入新失败，说明聚合有效率会掩盖失败成分的变化;据此给出校验器、schema、重试与评测四方面工程实践，并开源分类器、补全结果与标注。
arxiv.reason: 结构化输出失败实证，偏工程评测，方法增量有限

arxiv.title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
arxiv.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark, our approach substantially outperforms similarity-based retrieval methods, the dominant industry approach, in both executability and answer quality. On Beaver, we achieve 95.7% execution validity compared to 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, with expert data engineers preferring our system 70% to 10% on internal deployment. Our work demonstrates that text-to-SQL can operate effectively in schema-ambiguous enterprise environments, enabling natural language database interfaces "in the wild".
arxiv.titleZh: 无Schema的Text-to-SQL:从查询日志学习企业数据库结构
arxiv.summaryZh: 企业数据库普遍缺少完整schema文档、命名晦涩且关系隐式，使在学术基准上表现优异的Text-to-SQL系统在真实部署中准确率骤降。该工作提出首个无需schema文档的框架:从历史查询日志中挖掘结构知识——哪些表被共同查询、如何连接、哪些列对应业务概念，将解析出的查询模式构建为知识图谱，并配合实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，把用户问题锚定到领域术语而非仅依赖向量相似度。在Beaver基准上执行有效率达95.7%，基于嵌入的检索为60.8%;内部部署中数据工程师以70%对10%偏好该系统。结果表明schema歧义的企业环境下自然语言数据库接口具备可行性。
arxiv.reason: Text-to-SQL无schema方案，GraphRAG检索有工业验证

arxiv.title: Stable and Calibrated Latent Force ODE Filters
arxiv.abstract: Estimating unobserved forces in mechanistic systems is a central task of scientific machine learning. Approximate Gaussian filtering methods that synthesize mechanistic and empirical information have shown remarkable capacity in jointly identifying latent processes together with the system state in a single forward-backward pass. The resulting latent force ODE filter framework channels information from observational data specifically into the unknown parts of the system. This work addresses open questions about calibration and stability of the method. We show that the joint posterior over state and force is the reweighted conventional latent force posterior. This uncovers a crucial dependence of the stability of the method on the prior variance of the system state, which effectively controls the flow of information from observations to the latent force through the mechanistic system. From this insight, we construct an improved algorithm that provides stable and calibrated plug-and-play inference. We demonstrate the improved framework on several simulated experimental settings.
arxiv.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/paufisch/lfcal
arxiv.titleZh: 稳定且校准的隐力ODE滤波器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对机理系统（如由ODE描述的物理系统）中未观测力的估计问题，分析潜变量力ODE滤波器的校准性与数值稳定性。证明状态与力的联合后验等价于对常规隐力后验的重加权，由此揭示方法稳定性关键取决于系统状态的先验方差——该方差实质上控制了观测信息经由机理系统流向隐力的通道。据此给出改进算法，在多个模拟实验设定下实现稳定且校准的即插即用推断。适用于科学机器学习中机理模型与数据融合的场景。
arxiv.reason: 科学机器学习中的ODE滤波数值方法，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title
arxiv.abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.
arxiv.titleZh: HerHealthGPT：一个以证据为依据的女性生殖健康对话式 AI 系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对对话式 AI 在健康咨询中面对信息不全的提问直接作答、缺乏可核验依据的问题，构建了融合 RAG、上下文感知澄清与来源校验的交互式系统：系统维护对话上下文、主动提出针对性追问、检查过早结论，并以检索到的证据支撑回答。基于 90 个生殖健康案例衍生出的 540 条英文消息评测，证据检索将关切类别准确率从仅微调的 54.1% 提升至 59.3%，澄清路由召回率 85.6%、特异度 86.2%；30 人问卷中 83.3% 偏好启用检索的配置，25 人认为追问切题。该工作为需要透明、可溯源的垂直领域健康信息咨询提供了可借鉴的澄清与证据支撑范式，但临床有效性仍待验证。
arxiv.reason: 医疗垂直领域的 RAG 对话应用，与核心关注方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
arxiv.abstract: Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.
arxiv.titleZh: EnerGNN:为精确受约束组合推理学习与优化器兼容的能量函数
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基于学习的组合优化大多直接预测解或用预测缩小搜索空间、而表达能力强的能量模型又只能近似推理的问题，提出在完整二值配置上学习能量函数并用混合整数规划(MIP)在显式硬约束下精确最小化。方法上由 GNN 编码器、与优化器兼容的读出层和非线性能量头组成，并用最优性感知的对比损失让能量反映解的质量与约束违反程度。在二次背包、组合拍卖与个性化细胞治疗供应链问题上取得接近最优且 100% 可行的解，供应链任务平均 primal gap 0.05%、相对单体 MIP 加速 17.4 倍，能量还可泛化到更大规模实例并支持零样本注入新约束。
arxiv.reason: GNN 加 MIP 的组合优化工作，与 LLM 后训练、Agent 方向无实质交集

arxiv.title: WebViSE: Scaling Visual Design Intelligence from the Open Web for LLM Website Generation
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have made remarkable strides in website development, enabling complete and interactive web experiences to be built from natural-language instructions with far less effort. Yet, non-expert users often struggle to articulate sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language. Meanwhile, the open web already contains a vast reservoir of such design knowledge, embodied in mature website implementations. To this end, we introduce Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE), a framework that automatically abstracts these implementations into reusable Visual Skills and builds a structured Skill library. To scale the library, WebViSE organizes its Skills in a multi-parent DAG and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries, enabling efficient matching between diverse user instructions and relevant Skills. The auto-evolved structure outperforms non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines at only 39.09% of the estimated retrieval cost with Qwen3.8-Max. For any models, WebViSE can be directly injected as plug-and-play guidance, enabling diverse models to produce more visually compelling and aesthetically refined web pages. For open-source models, WebViSE can be used to build a data-synthesis pipeline that internalizes visual design intelligence into model weights. Experiments across multiple web development benchmarks and human evaluation consistently show that WebViSE improves the visual quality and interaction fidelity of artifacts. Overall, our work establishes an automated path for extracting, organizing, and transferring design intelligence from the open web to website-building models. We release all extracted Visual Skills, the associated Skill DAG, and our code at https://github.com/YifeiSun-0710/WebViSE.
arxiv.titleZh: WebViSE：从开放网络扩展视觉设计智能，用于 LLM 网站生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 非专家用户难以用自然语言描述复杂的视觉与交互设计，而开放网络上已有大量成熟网站可作为设计知识来源。WebViSE 将这些实现自动抽象为可复用的 Visual Skill，并用多父 DAG 组织技能库，借助技能条件下的潜在查询联合演化技能描述与图结构，实现用户指令与技能的高效匹配。该结构在仅约 39.09% 的检索成本下优于非层次化 LLM 检索基线，并可作为即插即用引导提升各类模型的网页视觉质量，也可通过数据合成将设计能力内化到开源模型权重中。
arxiv.reason: LLM 网页生成与技能库检索，属代码智能擦边，方法有增量

arxiv.title: Multitask Interactions in Recurrent Dynamics across 100 Cognitive Tasks
arxiv.abstract: The brain continually learns tasks with very different computational demands. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been used as dynamical surrogates for studying task solutions, with recent work extending this approach to joint training on multitask batteries. However, it remains unclear how tasks interact as these batteries grow in scale and heterogeneity: under what conditions do they transfer or interfere with one another, and how do these effects relate to task complexity and model structure? We study this question by simultaneously training hierarchical Almost-Linear RNNs (AL-RNNs) on 100 tasks spanning a wide range of cognitive demands. AL-RNNs allow us to vary the amount of nonlinearity in the recurrence, while hierarchical task features provide a low-dimensional interface for task-specific adaptation within shared dynamics. On this task battery, performance improves with both nonlinear capacity and task-feature dimensionality, with the joint hierarchical model outperforming both individually trained models and a single unstructured joint model. Many tasks are individually solvable with linear dynamics, yet cannot be solved together by a shared linear model. Through hierarchical task features, task-specific linear region usage, and task geometry, the trained model provides several related but distinct measures of task similarity that capture how computations are separated and combined within the shared backbone. Across a series of experiments, we relate these representations to individual task complexity, joint solvability, pairwise transfer learning, and leave-one-out adaptation. Together, our experiments characterize task interactions in multitask recurrent learning while demonstrating both the potential and the challenges of reusable dynamical backbones for cognitive computation.
arxiv.titleZh: 跨100个认知任务的循环动力学中的多任务交互
arxiv.summaryZh: 用分层Almost-Linear RNN（AL-RNN）在覆盖广泛认知需求的100个任务上联合训练，考察任务规模与异质性增大时迁移与干扰的条件。任务特征提供低维接口，使共享循环动力学可按任务调节，并可通过非线性容量与任务特征维度控制模型结构。结果显示性能随非线性容量和特征维度提升，分层联合模型优于单独训练模型和单一无结构联合模型；许多任务线性动力学即可单独求解，却无法由共享线性模型共同求解。基于任务特征、任务特定线性区域使用与任务几何得到的多种任务相似度度量，可关联单任务复杂度、联合可解性、成对迁移与留一适应，揭示共享动力学骨架的复用潜力与局限。该工作属计算神经科学方向的RNN多任务学习，与LLM后训练、Agent等关注方向无直接交集。
arxiv.reason: RNN认知任务多任务动力学，与LLM方向无直接关联

arxiv.title: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow
arxiv.abstract: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demonstrating competitive performance in learning both balanced and unbalanced population dynamics compared with state-of-the-art methods.
arxiv.titleZh: 用变分Doob-Wasserstein流学习群体动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对黎曼Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao(WFR)流形上的非平衡群体动力学学习，提出免模拟的变分Doob-Wasserstein流(VDWF)，理论基础是非平衡平均场Schrödinger桥。方法分别学习带数据依赖度量的几何模型以刻画动力学的内在几何结构，借助Doob h-变换引入边界信息改进轨迹推断，并用增长模型在WFR空间免模拟地构造中间质量样本以处理非平衡传输。在均匀Log-Sobolev不等式下分析了收敛速率，多个真实数据集上在平衡与非平衡动力学学习上取得与SOTA相当的结果，适用于需要几何感知与非平衡质量变化的分布演化建模。
arxiv.reason: 最优传输与生成流理论工作，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
arxiv.abstract: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.
arxiv.titleZh: OS-Wizard：通过知识引导探索将计算机使用Agent扩展到专用软件
arxiv.summaryZh: 专用桌面软件的高质量交互轨迹稀缺，受限于应用知识不足、GUI 流程繁琐与探索不完整。OS-Wizard 是自动化轨迹采集框架：用教程引导探索注入应用特定知识，采用 GUI 与代码混合动作空间直接执行应用原生命令以简化流程，并在树式探索中对关键状态做检查点与回访以覆盖替代工作流，补充线性 rollout。采集 10.9K 条轨迹、54.9K 状态-动作样本，微调开源基座后在专用桌面工作流基准上提升 58.2 个百分点至 64.1%，超过人类 59.8% 的水平；仅用 GUI 动作时通用桌面任务亦有提升，消融显示代码动作不可替代。
arxiv.reason: CUA 轨迹合成，混合 GUI-代码动作空间与树式探索，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate method that selects among CTTA methods. Empirically, we find that Select-CTTA outperforms test-time baselines and approaches the performance of models fine-tuned on shortcut-balanced data.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于语言模型捷径去除的反事实测试时增强
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 可能利用训练数据中未必在测试时成立的伪相关（捷径），分布漂移时预测会显著退化，而去捷径方法多依赖训练期干预，需标注数据、权重访问与大量算力。为此研究测试时捷径去除，提出反事实测试时增强（CTTA）方法族：借助辅助模型对样本做改变捷径取值的反事实编辑，再对这些编辑下的 LLM 预测加权平均。理论证明最优捷径不变预测器属于该 CTTA 族并刻画其权重，指出权重一般不可由模型与无标注测试数据辨识，但在特定假设下可由 token 概率获得，并给出假设违背的检验方法，进而构建在 CTTA 方法间做选择的 Select-CTTA。实验显示 Select-CTTA 优于测试时基线，接近在捷径平衡数据上微调的模型。
arxiv.reason: 测试时去捷径，属后训练与评测可靠性方向，方法与理论清晰

arxiv.title: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
arxiv.abstract: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.
arxiv.titleZh: 当人格设定变得有害：以全球公民价值观对齐引导 LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 人格条件化（persona-conditioned）请求往往不含明显恶意，导致针对对抗请求的对齐方法失效，模型要么拒绝合法的价值表达，要么盲从有害人格。工作构建了 11k 争议话题与基于 Schwartz 价值观维度的人格配对数据集，并用迭代精炼话题与人格的 agentic pipeline 从对齐良好的商业 LLM 中诱导出有害回答，成功率超过 47%。以 UNESCO 全球公民原则作为区分合法价值表达与有害行为的最小共识，训练出可控对齐模型，使用户可在推理时权衡人格遵循与安全。所得模型在多数样本上比基线更安全且更人格遵循，适用于人格化对话与价值观敏感场景的安全部署。
arxiv.reason: 人格条件化请求的安全对齐，配套数据集与可控对齐模型，属对齐方向

arxiv.title: Min-Marginal Power Indices for Multi-Objective Feature Selection
arxiv.abstract: Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions. An average shows whether a feature helps overall, but not whether, in some coalition, adding it turns an acceptable model into an unacceptable one. Building on minimum marginal aggregation, we define the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game. For a fixed quota, MinPI takes the value -1, 0, or +1 and labels each feature harmful, neutral, or decisive. A harmful label carries its own evidence, an evaluated coalition in which adding the feature drops utility below the quota, so no score cutoff is needed; finite-budget estimators keep this property but may miss harmful features. We use MinPI to propose feature removals, which are accepted only if they pass a validation gate, and to prefilter multi-objective search. On six benchmark datasets over five seeds, MinPI removed 12.5% of analyzed features with almost no loss of held-out utility. On Madelon and Abalone, where it removed the most, its removals cost far less held-out utility than random removals of the same size. Prefiltering increased the dataset-averaged hypervolume of multi-objective search in all five seeds. MinPI is therefore a conservative feature-deletion step whose gains are largest where the data contain many removable features.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多目标特征选择的最小边际功效指数
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对博弈论特征选择只用平均边际贡献、无法判断某特征在某些联盟中会把可接受模型拖成不可接受模型的问题，提出最小边际功效指数（MinPI）：在二元效用阈值博弈上按固定配额取-1、0、+1，把特征标为有害、中性或关键，且「有害」标签自带一个使效用跌破配额的实证联盟，无需分数阈值。基于该指数提出特征删除建议，须通过验证门控才被接受，并用于多目标搜索的预筛选。六个基准、五个随机种子上删除12.5%特征而留出效用几乎不降；在 Madelon 与 Abalone 上同等规模删除的效用损失远低于随机删除，预筛选在全部五个种子上提升了数据集平均超体积。
arxiv.reason: 博弈论特征选择与多目标搜索，非LLM方向，仅方法学上略沾边

arxiv.title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $σ$-Weighted Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $σ$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $σ$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates $σ$ with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to $13.8%$ and $11.2%$, halve residual drag, improve accuracy from $47.5%$ to $48.7%$ and $49.3%$, and transfer to held-out GSM8K without retuning.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026; see https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-emnlp.2090/
arxiv.titleZh: 干预认证放大：σ加权后训练的有效性门控
arxiv.summaryZh: SFT/RL混合后训练常用训练侧信号逐样本设置权重，却无法判断被强化的行为是否真对目标任务与评测环境有利。以DIAA（逐样本σ加权SFT/RL混合）为例：即使锚数据中已删除全部Python代码围栏，模型仍在29%的MATH-500题目上输出未执行的工具集成推理（TIR），是vanilla GRPO的三倍；配对干预显示抑制TIR可回升10.6个百分点准确率，SFT模仿与σ放大各有贡献。提出的干预认证放大（ICA）用配对rollout的目标侧证据对σ设门控，冻结与在线两版将TIR降至13.8%与11.2%，准确率从47.5%升至48.7%与49.3%，并零调参迁移至GSM8K。
arxiv.reason: 后训练加权与行为放大的失效分析，方法清晰且命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: DIGEST: Discovery-Guided LLM Tuning for Symbolic Regression
arxiv.abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. To more thoroughly utilize search discoveries, high-quality expressions discovered by GP are fed back to update the LLM-derived policy online, thereby enabling the LLM to progressively internalize past search discoveries and translate them into improved subsequent population generation. Experiments show that on two ground-truth benchmarks, DIGEST outperforms the strongest competitor by up to 2.59% in recovery. Among LLM-based baselines, it improves recovery by at least 54.91% while using at most 17.4% of the strongest competitor's mean search time. On 122 BlackBox datasets, DIGEST achieves the highest accuracy while maintaining a moderate model complexity.
arxiv.titleZh: DIGEST:面向符号回归的发现引导式 LLM 调优
arxiv.summaryZh: 符号回归要从数据直接恢复数学表达式，而现有搜索方法候选生成僵化、LLM 方法难以利用搜索中已发现的表达式。DIGEST 将轻量 LLM 的一个预训练解码器块改造为符号策略，为遗传规划(GP)的种群播种，以借用 LLM 的建模能力提升生成灵活性;再把 GP 找到的高质量表达式在线回流更新该策略，使 LLM 逐步内化历史搜索发现。在两个真值基准上恢复率最高超过最强基线 2.59%，相较 LLM 类基线恢复率至少提升 54.91%，平均搜索时间仅为最强对手的 17.4%;在 122 个 BlackBox 数据集上取得最高精度且模型复杂度适中。
arxiv.reason: LLM 驱动符号回归，属自动发现方向，但非核心后训练或 Agent 议题

arxiv.title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder
arxiv.abstract: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. Unlike multidimensional scaling and many metric-learning approaches that preserve sample-level relationships, ICE operates on class centroids, preserving inter-class geometry without requiring large numbers of sample-pair or triplet constraints. We further show that the intrinsic dimensionality required to represent the centroid-distance configuration of $M$ classes is at most $M-1$, explaining the observed saturation of distance-preservation measures as the latent dimensionality increases. To quantify embedding reproducibility, we introduce the Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS) metric, which measures the consistency of class-level neighborhood topology across independent runs and complements existing embedding quality measures. Experiments on image and biological datasets demonstrate that ICE produces stable embeddings with improved preservation of class-centroid geometry while remaining computationally efficient. Additional analyses of optimization dynamics, sensitivity, and preprocessing further provide practical insights into latent dimensionality and explicit geometry modeling for supervised dimensionality reduction.
arxiv.titleZh: 等距质心编码器：稳定降维方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 监督降维常只追求类内紧凑与类间可分，却未约束类别间的相对几何，导致多次独立训练得到的低维嵌入结构不一致、难以复现与解释。为此提出等距质心编码器（ICE）：在隐空间中直接学习类质心，并施加预设的类质心两两几何（距离）约束，从而显式正则化类别的相对排布；与需要大量样本对或三元组约束的度量学习不同，它只需在类质心层面保持类间几何。作者进一步证明表示 M 个类别的质心距离构型所需内在维度至多为 M−1，可解释距离保持指标随维度上升而饱和的现象，并提出质心邻域稳定性（CNS）指标度量多次运行的类级邻域拓扑一致性。图像与生物数据实验显示 ICE 在保持类质心几何的同时得到更稳定的嵌入，且计算开销较低。
arxiv.reason: 经典监督降维方法，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
arxiv.abstract: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. On matched BrowseComp-Plus subsets, ReGE-Syn reduces guidance-construction tokens by 98.2\% on GPT and 95.5\% on Claude relative to adapted AggAgent, with observed success. Combined construction and execution tokens decrease by 15.7\% and 35.4\%, respectively, counting input plus output and excluding source generation. BrowseComp-Plus ablations further associate access to process information with fewer student steps and show that joint synthesis produces substantially shorter guidance than Direct history or Independent summaries, with observed success. These results demonstrate how agents can use their own recorded experience to improve subsequent task completion, and suggest a low-cost way to consolidate the execution records of parallel agent systems such as agent swarms.
arxiv.titleZh: ReGE：通过经验合成打造更强的智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 交互任务中反复尝试积累的事实、有效操作与失败教训未被系统利用。ReGE 将这些执行记录转化为下一次尝试的指导：其实现 ReGE-Syn 用一次 coach 调用，把受长度约束的执行记录与可用产物联合合成为自包含的指导文本，把任务相关发现、建议动作与易踩的坑串联起来；学生在任务初始环境状态下执行，并据当前观测自适应调整这份指导。来源生成、合成与学生执行共用同一基座模型，不做参数更新，也不依赖更强的教师模型。四个 benchmark 上，GPT 与 Claude 的平均准确率分别提升 9.9 与 8.8 个百分点；BrowseComp-Plus 匹配子集上指导构建 token 较 AggAgent 分别降低 98.2% 与 95.5%，构建加执行总 token 降低 15.7% 与 35.4%。消融显示过程信息可用可减少学生步数，联合合成产出的指导显著短于直接历史或独立摘要，为并行智能体系统（如 agent swarm）的执行记录整合提供了低成本路径。
arxiv.reason: Agent 经验合成与执行指导，属 Agent 方向扎实工作且有系统消融

arxiv.title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
arxiv.abstract: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. Fuse Desktop, an open-source local version, is available at https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop.
arxiv.titleZh: Numina Fuse：Lean 4 中的交互式自动形式化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Lean 4 形式化中代码虽可编译却未必符合非形式语义、且智能体产出速度远超人工审阅的问题，构建以人监督智能体工作为核心的 agent 原生应用：用户通过 blueprint、依赖图与 Lean 代码三个视图监督 AI orchestrator，后端维护项目派生状态，支持无人值守连续运行数小时；架构由人工节奏的固定流水线演进为自主分派专家、证明器与并行子智能体的 orchestrator，并将项目状态、工具链、界面与编排解耦，以便随模型变强逐步移交工作。系统用于三维 Kakeya 猜想的形式化与证明器模型研究，并给出下一代自动形式化系统的经验教训，开源本地版 Fuse Desktop 已发布。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 与自动形式化系统级工作，含 Kakeya 实战

arxiv.title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
arxiv.abstract: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.
arxiv.titleZh: 软件工程 LLM：为何需要它们，以及软件工程如何帮助构建它们
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向服务超过 10 万名开发者的 92B 参数代码大模型，开展以能力为导向的训练：用软件工程知识确定需要训练哪些工程能力、构造可验证数据并评估模型改进。针对仓库级重构，构建 RefactorForge 流水线，结合重构知识、成熟 SE 工具与验证技术，在 306 个 Python 仓库上生成 5704 个可执行任务，保留 4572 条验证通过的教师轨迹，共 7251 万 token。仅占前序代码混合数据 0.46% token 的增量 SFT，使 RefactorBench 提升 18.00 个百分点、SWE-Bench ProMax 提升 7.06 点；在 OpenCode 下 SWE-Bench Verified 与 SWE-Bench Pro 分别提升 4.97 与 1.23 点，且改进跨多种 agent harness 保持，greenfield 仓库生成则结果不一。基于此提出把代码 LLM 转变为 SE LLM 的研究议程。
arxiv.reason: 工业级代码 LLM 能力训练与可验证数据构造，命中代码智能与后训练

arxiv.title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
arxiv.abstract: Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. For kernel gradient flow on a synthetic noisy classification task, we derive sharp high-dimensional learning curves and obtain a phase diagram controlled by the balance between the linear kernel component that learns the shared relation between inputs and labels and the higher-order components that enable fitting the label noise. In one regime, generalization is optimized at finite time and early stopping is necessary. In another, generalization improves until interpolation, but the endpoint is suboptimal across kernels. At the boundary, the interpolating endpoint attains the lowest generalization error across the considered kernel family and all training times. Thus, even with extensive irreducible label noise, interpolation can outperform early stopping. The neural-network experiments leave open how learned representations acquire an analogous favorable geometry.
arxiv.titleZh: 标签噪声下早停何时有益？核梯度流的相图
arxiv.summaryZh: 质疑标签噪声下必须早停的假设：CIFAR10随机标签实验显示，固定特征与浅层模型后期测试误差会恶化，但更大更深的卷积网络在完全拟合随机标签后仍基本无需早停。对合成噪声分类任务推导核梯度流的高维精确学习曲线，给出由学习输入—标签共享关系的线性核成分与拟合噪声的高阶成分之平衡控制的相图。相图包含需有限时间早停与泛化持续改善至插值两类区间，边界处插值端点在所考察核族与所有训练时间上取得最低泛化误差，表明大量不可约标签噪声下插值也可能优于早停；神经网络如何获得类似有利几何仍待研究。
arxiv.reason: 纯核梯度流学习理论，与LLM关注方向无直接关联

arxiv.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
arxiv.abstract: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.
arxiv.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern
arxiv.titleZh: 构建，而非游玩:自我改进的 LLM 研究智能体开发出媲美顶尖玩家的炉石传说酒馆战棋 AI
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察 LLM 研究智能体能否从原始数据出发，自主把一个困难现实问题推进到可与人类高手对抗的系统。AutoTavern 让多个专职研究智能体共享带类型的科研记忆，每条主张都经过验证门控，并以真实对局闭环反馈，使智能体同时改进模拟器、对手与策略，以及自身的研究流程，人类只设定目标并裁决模糊机制。20 天内该系统构建出完整复现线上对局内容的 TavernGym，并用 PPO 训练出 23 个版本的 TavernAgent，其在真实天梯的评分从 6000 升至约 15000，最近 20 局平均名次 1.60、80% 吃鸡，全面优于服务器前十名(2.34、59%)。TavernBench 的 960 个任务显示，智能体自建的系统答题率 91%，远超前沿 LLM 的 63%，决策耗时 0.03 s 对比最高 26 s，为科研智能体自动化系统构建提供了可复现的范例。
arxiv.reason: 自我改进科研智能体闭环构建系统并训练策略，直击 Agent 与 AI for Research

arxiv.title: Approximate Universal Prediction under Interaction
arxiv.abstract: Bayesian mixtures, and Solomonoff induction in particular, provide an idealized model of prediction learned by minimizing population log loss, and they underlie universal agents such as AIXI. An agent that plans with an approximation of such a predictor decides where that predictor is evaluated, and a planner can be drawn toward branches on which its model is optimistic. We study which approximation guarantees survive this feedback. For normalized finite-horizon causal mixtures, the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence available before each prediction, so task rarity and action-branch rarity can compound. Within one fixed universal mixture, infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order $κη\,2^{K(μ)}$, where $η$ is the training KL budget and $κ$ measures policy coverage. This order is sharp, and for each target a computable predictor attains it at a suitable finite horizon, so computability alone does not remove the penalty. For bounded returns, value error is controlled by the probability of entering a poorly covered branch plus a square-root term in $η$. Both terms are necessary, and finite maximum coverage ratios are not required. Motivated by the mentor override of Golden Handcuffs, we derive margins for preserving deferral decisions and conditional KL budgets with an unavoidable inverse-history-probability penalty, and a counterexample separates agreement of deferral decisions from task-wise event avoidance. The guarantees apply to any predictor architecture that meets explicit population approximation and coverage conditions, which gives concrete targets for implementing idealized universal agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 交互下的近似通用预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究当预测器被自身规划器选择评估分支、从而形成反馈回路时，近似通用预测器(贝叶斯混合、Solomonoff 归纳)还能保留哪些保证:规划器会被模型乐观的分支吸引。对归一化有限时程因果混合，证明转移系数可分解为策略似然比与每次预测前可得的任务证据之乘积，因此任务稀有性与动作分支稀有性会相互叠加;在固定的通用混合内，存在无穷多个可计算环境，其超额预测误差达 κη2^{K(μ)} 量级(η 为训练 KL 预算，κ 度量策略覆盖)，该阶数是紧的，且可计算性本身不能消除这一惩罚。对有界回报，值误差由进入覆盖不足分支的概率加上 η 的平方根项控制，两项均不可省略。还给出保持延迟(deferral)决策的边际条件与带逆历史概率惩罚的条件 KL 预算，结论适用于满足显式总体近似与覆盖条件的任意预测器架构，为落地理想化通用智能体给出可操作指标。
arxiv.reason: 通用预测与 AIXI 的纯理论分析，与 LLM 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: Sliding Networks: A Family of Residual Structures Preserving Feature Learning and Feature Diversity
arxiv.abstract: Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths. The growing interest in scaling laws, especially in the language modeling domain, has motivated procedures for scaling up network widths and depths in order to preserve stability and computational efficiency of training dynamics. Existing depth-scaling approaches force a choice between retaining locally maximal \emph{feature learning} and preserving a form of \emph{feature diversity} in the residual stream arising from random differences between channels. We examine a \textit{joint scaling recipe} that preserves both. With residual width $N_\flat$, hidden width $N_\sharp$, and depth $L$, the key quantity is, by default, the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\toα$, while correlated initialization (Half Copy) can partially relax the resulting shape constraints. Theory and residual-MLP experiments support convergence at fixed positive $α$ to an SDE limit with locally maximal feature learning. Hidden computations can then be redistributed between width and depth while preserving this limit, like turning melody into harmony and back. Language-model experiments nevertheless show performance differences under regrouping at fixed parameter count. These results distinguish approximating a limit (ODE or SDE) from scaling for better performance.
arxiv.titleZh: 滑动网络：一族保持特征学习与特征多样性的残差结构
arxiv.summaryZh: 残差网络的深度缩放此前只能在「局部最大特征学习」与「通道随机差异带来的特征多样性」之间二选一。该工作提出滑动网络家族与联合缩放配方：以残差宽度 N♭、隐藏宽度 N♯、深度 L 的极限比 N♭/(N♯L)→α 为核心量，配合 Half Copy 相关初始化部分放宽形状约束，理论上证明固定正 α 时收敛到 SDE 极限且保持局部最大特征学习。由此可在宽度与深度之间重分配隐藏计算量而不改变该极限，但语言模型实验显示固定参数量下重新分组仍带来性能差异，说明「逼近极限」与「为更好性能而缩放」是两件事。
arxiv.reason: 残差结构与深度缩放律的理论工作，命中架构与 scaling law 方向

arxiv.title: EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data
arxiv.abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.
arxiv.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Code: https://github.com/BardiaKh/EdgeDeID ; models and data: https://huggingface.co/EdgeDeID
arxiv.titleZh: EdgeDeID：无需真实患者数据训练的0.6B临床去标识化模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床文本去标识化若调用托管大模型，等于把本应保护的信息外泄。EdgeDeID用三个LLM教师合成病历、单一标注器统一标注规范，训练0.6B仅解码器模型以带类型的XML模式输出识别到的标识符，可完全本地运行。在100条人工校验的合成域内基准上达到0.994 micro-F1、99%病历无漏检标识符，而八个现成系统中最佳者仅为0.857与12%;量化后仅615MB并可在CPU运行。迁移到MIMIC ICU护理记录时F1降至0.48，误差源于电报式文体与低标识符密度，三个手写上下文示例即可在无标注目标数据下挽回0.08 F1。
arxiv.reason: LLM合成数据训练小模型思路可借鉴，但属临床去标识垂直应用

arxiv.title: Hessian-Similar Optimization with Capped Participation: Lower Bounds and Virtual Masters
arxiv.abstract: What is the round complexity of Hessian-similar optimization when each round can contact at most $s$ of $m$ clients? Prior rates permit a free master or full participation and do not characterize strict caps. We count every one-vector query and reply. A hidden-client chain gives a lower bound for zero-respecting local algorithms with adaptive cohorts and random stopping: on strongly convex quadratics, the required rounds are $Ω((m/s)\sqrt{\min\{δ_a,\barδ/\sqrt m\}/μ}\,\log(1/ε))$ for $s\leq(m-2)/2$ in the high-accuracy, high-dissimilarity regime. Here $μ$ is strong convexity, while $δ_a$ and $\barδ$ bound anchor and average Hessian variation. To remove dependence on a poor anchor, virtual-master SVRS uses independent estimator and proximal cohorts and averages the proximal replies. With Catalyst, it reaches relative gap $ε$ in $\tilde O(m/s+(\sqrt{m/s}+m^{3/4}/s)\sqrt{\barδ/μ})$ expected rounds on quadratics with strongly convex clients, independent of $δ_a$. Combining this method with charged analyses of existing algorithms matches the lower bound's polynomial dependence for $s\leq\sqrt m$ and $s=Ω(m)$; the worst gap is $O(m^{1/8})$. A held-out 12-seed synthetic study finds fewer rounds than tuned SVRP in nine of ten dip-family incomplete-cohort cells, versus two of 30 other cells. The lower bounds concern zero-respecting algorithms and do not cover unrestricted messages.
arxiv.titleZh: Hessian 相似优化中的受限参与：下界与虚拟 Master
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究每轮最多联系 m 个客户端中 s 个时，Hessian 相似优化的轮复杂度：既有收敛率要么假设存在免费主节点，要么要求所有客户端参与，无法刻画严格的参与上限，并且把每次单向量查询与回复都计入开销。通过隐藏客户端链，为零尊重（zero-respecting）局部算法给出在强凸二次函数上的轮数下界，该下界依赖锚点与平均 Hessian 差异。提出 virtual-master SVRS：使用独立估计队列与近端队列，并对近端回复取平均；配合 Catalyst 后，期望轮数与锚点差异 δ_a 无关，且在 s≤√m、s=Ω(m) 时与下界的多项式依赖关系吻合，最坏差距为 O(m^{1/8})；12 种子的合成实验在 10 个不完整队列单元中的 9 个优于调优 SVRP。
arxiv.reason: 分布式凸优化下界理论，与 LLM 训练关联很弱

arxiv.title: EEGBiFormer: Real-Time EEG Attention Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformer with EEG-Informed Auditory Protocol Validation
arxiv.abstract: Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. In a paired within-subject behavioral study with 37 participants, these protocols produced a statistically significant 20 percent improvement in composite attention scores over silent controls, with a medium-to-large effect size. This work demonstrates a complete pipeline from custom EEG hardware through neural signal analysis, deep learning classification, and evidence-based auditory protocol design.
arxiv.titleZh: EEGBiFormer：混合CNN-Transformer的实时EEG注意力分类及EEG引导听觉协议的验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向注意力状态实时判别：现有听觉辅助工具只做静态播放，缺乏实时神经证据支撑。工作搭建了16通道EEG模拟前端采集板并自建任务态数据集，先用功率谱密度与相位锁定值确认专注与非专注状态的神经特征差异，再用CNN-Transformer混合模型做窗级二分类；窗级验证准确率91.3%、F1为94.5%，在17段独立记录上记录级准确率88.2%，端到端延迟低于100ms。模型输出还被用来按专注置信度对听觉刺激排序，形成EEG引导的音频协议，37人被试内配对实验显示复合注意力评分较静默对照提升20%，效应量中到大。
arxiv.reason: EEG注意力分类与听觉干预，属脑机接口与生物医学，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: Reactive Optimizers
arxiv.abstract: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.
arxiv.comment: This document is a static version of our blog post. We recommend the original interactive version at https://xingjianbai.com/reactive-optimizers/. We release the code at https://github.com/xingjian-bai/opal
arxiv.titleZh: 反应式优化器
arxiv.summaryZh: 用预训练语言模型智能体在单次训练过程中检视训练动态并重写可执行优化器代码，无需针对优化器做元训练，也不依赖跨运行迁移的记忆，即可按参数组调整更新规则与学习率计划。在语言建模与图像生成任务上，当配方未针对目标设定调优时，OPAL 匹配或优于若干固定配方。对智能体决策的分析显示，它改变了学习率计划、优化器结构、数值精度与动量；控制实验还显示其能适应重复的数据损坏并降低过拟合。该工作把优化器设计从人工调参转为运行时自动改写，适用于配方未调优的新设定，并报告了计算成本与实现要求。
arxiv.reason: LLM智能体自动改写优化器代码，属优化器与LLM结合的系统性工作

arxiv.title: Learning What to Share: Expert Specialization for Time-Series Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: A central challenge in multivariate forecasting is deciding what to share across channels and where to specialize. Mixture-of-experts models offer flexible sharing, yet it remains unclear how much of their forecasting gains comes from added capacity or expert allocation. Through controlled comparisons across eleven datasets and three backbones, we show that informative channel assignments improve forecasting beyond matched shared capacity and random allocation. On frozen transformer backbones, persistent channel-specific mixtures outperform input-dependent routing on average. To examine when and how much specialization helps, we introduce GalaxyTS, a controlled synthetic dataset with exact shared and channel-specific forecasting references. It reveals how persistent channel mixtures exploit predictive differences concealed by short input windows and measures gains over matched shared corrections. These insights motivate Persistent Closed-Form Routing (PCR), a plug-and-play method that alternates exact conditional estimation of channel-specific mixture weights with gradient-based training of low-rank residual experts around a frozen pretrained forecaster. Averaged over four forecasting horizons, PCR-K4 achieves dataset-balanced mean squared error reductions of 3.86-14.25% relative to the three frozen backbones. In matched comparisons, PCR outperforms competing specialization methods on average while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习共享什么:专家特化用于时间序列预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 多变量时间序列预测的核心难题是决定跨通道共享哪些信息、在哪里做特化;MoE 提供了灵活共享，但其收益究竟来自容量还是专家分配并不清楚。在 11 个数据集、3 个骨干上的受控对比显示，有信息量的通道分配优于同等共享容量与随机分配，且在冻结 Transformer 骨干上持久通道特化平均优于输入相关路由;为此构建带精确共享与通道特化参考的合成数据集 GalaxyTS，并提出即插即用的持久闭式路由(PCR)，在冻结预训练预测器周围交替做通道混合权重的精确条件估计与低秩残差专家的梯度训练。四个预测步长平均下，PCR-K4 相对三个冻结骨干取得 3.86–14.25% 的数据集均衡 MSE 下降，且在匹配比较中以显著更少可训练参数优于同类特化方法。
arxiv.reason: MoE 通道特化用于时序预测，与 LLM 后训练方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
arxiv.abstract: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.
arxiv.titleZh: EnvLunch：把环境当作免费午餐，用于学习交互
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向智能体式数据分析，训练 LLM agent 与可执行环境（数据库）交互通常依赖大量人工标注任务，而环境本身已提供丰富的交互结构和可验证结果。EnvLunch 据此设计一个免标注的预热阶段：采样合法的动作轨迹并执行得到最终观测，再训练模型仅凭最终观测重建一条功能等价的轨迹，随后才进入下游 agentic RL。该预热在所有下游训练预算下平均超过基线 9 分以上；在标注极少时，基线需要 8 至 32 倍的标注样本才能追平 EnvLunch 最小预算的准确率，且优于让模型自行生成任务的做法，并能迁移到数据分析之外的微调基准。
arxiv.reason: 环境自监督预热 + Agentic RL，免标注且增益明显

arxiv.title: Memory or a Clock? Auditing a Memory Advantage in XLand-MiniGrid with Seeds, Maps and Evaluation Noise Apart
arxiv.abstract: On a partially observable XLand-MiniGrid task, an LSTM agent beats a memory-free MLP by 25 percentage points. The gap looks like a clear case of memory. We ask two questions about it. First, how much of a measured gap is noise? Separating training seed, map and evaluation randomness in 60 runs, each re-evaluated three times, we find that about ten paired seeds detect a 10-point gap in final success. The binary "task acquired" verdict, a common summary of learning curves, is 76% evaluation noise and would need about a hundred seeds for the same gap. Second, is the gap memory? On a sealed panel of new maps, opened once, a memory-free MLP of the LSTM's size comes within 3.3 points of the LSTM when it is given the time step, and gains no measurable benefit from its width without it. With the time step, an MLP a quarter of the LSTM's size, and the LSTM with its state erased at every step, also come within about 5 points. A linear probe reads the time step from the trained LSTM's state. On this task, most of the apparent memory advantage is an advantage of knowing the time, which matters because episodes are cut at a fixed limit and the reward shrinks with time. We recommend giving memory-free baselines the time step, and we release the protocol, the event-driven tooling and every checkpoint.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/Effiani-Core/memory-or-clock . Data and checkpoints: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23512311
arxiv.titleZh: 记忆还是时钟？在XLand-MiniGrid中分离种子、地图与评估噪声以审计记忆优势
arxiv.summaryZh: 在部分可观测的XLand-MiniGrid任务上，LSTM比无记忆MLP高25个百分点，看似是记忆的功劳。用60次运行、每次三次重评估分离训练种子、地图与评估随机性后发现，约十个配对种子即可检出10个百分点的成功率差距，而常用的「任务是否学会」二值判定有76%是评估噪声，需约百个种子。在一次性开启的新地图密封面板上，给MLP输入时间步后它与LSTM的差距缩至3.3个百分点，四分之一大小的MLP及每步清空状态的LSTM也仅差约5个百分点，线性探针还能从LSTM状态中读出时间步。因此大部分表观记忆优势实为「知道时间」的优势（回合长度固定、奖励随时间衰减），建议无记忆基线同样输入时间步，并公开协议、事件驱动工具与全部checkpoint。
arxiv.reason: RL环境中的评估噪声与基线公平性审计，方法学可迁移但非LLM主线

arxiv.title: Task Format as a Factor in Adaptation: A Controlled Comparison of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning for Prompt-Safety Classification
arxiv.abstract: Fine-tuning a language model for classification involves many design decisions. Comparisons of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with full fine-tuning are common but often confounded, and task format is rarely studied. We compare both regimes on prompt-safety classification with a matched 400M encoder-decoder pair (Ettin) across three task formats, with up to 15 seeds per cell and pre-specified analyses. At the pre-specified learning rates, full fine-tuning leads LoRA by 2-3 pp in every architecture and format trained on the label alone. On the encoder, the gap closes once both rates are chosen by the same search. Training LoRA to write a reason after its verdict adds 4.0 pp and closes the gap, but a content-free sentence of equal length does not. Trained models score above a prompted 8B in domain but fall behind it on two of three out-of-distribution corpora, trailing by 8-23 pp on adversarial jailbreaks and flagging 27-66% of benign but harmful-looking prompts as unsafe, against the 8B's 2-3%. Together, the results suggest that the adaptation regime matters less than how each model is trained, its learning rate, and training target, and that in-domain accuracy alone is an incomplete guide to robustness.
arxiv.comment: 33 pages (14 pages main text, plus references and appendices), 1 figure, 18 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 任务格式作为适配中的因素：LoRA 与全量微调在提示安全分类上的受控比较
arxiv.summaryZh: 在提示安全分类任务上，用匹配的 400M 编码器-解码器模型（Ettin）对比 LoRA 与全量微调，覆盖三种任务格式、每格最多 15 个种子，并采用预注册分析。预设学习率下全量微调在各架构与格式上领先 LoRA 2–3 个百分点，编码器上两侧学习率经同一搜索选定后差距消失；让 LoRA 在给出判定后生成理由可提升 4.0 个百分点并抹平差距，等长但无内容的句子则无效。模型域内优于提示的 8B，但在三个分布外语料中的两个落后 8–23 个百分点，并把 27–66% 良性却看似有害的提示判为不安全（8B 为 2–3%）。说明适配方式的影响小于训练目标与学习率选择，域内准确率不足以反映鲁棒性。
arxiv.reason: LoRA 与全量微调的受控对比，属后训练但落在安全分类小模型，分量有限

arxiv.title: Rectified Language Flow
arxiv.abstract: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.
arxiv.titleZh: 整流语言流
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对连续态流与扩散模型在语言生成上难以匹敌自回归质量的问题，提出 ReLF：用整流流把噪声输运到 token 嵌入，结合 Hellinger-SVD 构造的固定 token 嵌入、以交叉熵训练的 self-conditioning 引导、正则化 reflow 实现少步生成，并引入 singular logits（解析项驱动噪声消失时收敛到合法 token 嵌入，加有界神经残差学习上下文偏好）。在 OpenWebText 上，64 次函数评估时三个模型规模的生成困惑度均低于同多样性的自回归基线，优于此前连续流方法；两轮 reflow 后仅 16 次评估仍超过自回归基线，且 batch size 1 下生成 1024 token 序列快 15–19 倍。
arxiv.reason: 连续流语言模型替代自回归，架构与采样效率方向扎实有新意

arxiv.title: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
arxiv.abstract: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.
arxiv.titleZh: IntentDelta：面向演化用户意图的人工构建基准
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM Agent 在复杂任务中需随用户对需求与优先级的修改而调整行为，现有评测缺少多轮意图演变的标注数据。IntentDelta 在 WebShop 与 TravelPlanner 上人工构建 638 条轨迹、3766 轮对话，每轮标注用户话语、累积意图状态与人类参考动作，覆盖可行性驱动和偏好驱动的约束与优先级变化。评测 11 个 Agent，TravelPlanner 平均意图恢复率 33.1%、动作得分 31.6%，WebShop 为 44.7% 与 41.0%；Agent 难以保持早期需求、难以区分软偏好与硬约束，且意图恢复正确并不保证执行成功。该基准可用于诊断动态意图跟踪与执行衔接的失效环节。
arxiv.reason: Agent 多轮意图评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Beyond Static Structures: Linking Protein Dynamics to Function via DynaReason-Pro
arxiv.abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) carry out their functions through heterogeneous conformational ensembles that reflect their dynamics, yet most protein function prediction methods rely on sequence or a single static structure. To this end, we introduce DynaReason-Pro, the first framework to jointly predict GO terms from conformational ensembles and generate natural-language functional rationales. We evaluate DynaReason-Pro on a curated IDP benchmark from the Protein Ensemble Database (PED), with sequence- and structure-cluster-disjoint splits to prevent data leakage. Variability-stratified evaluation shows the clearest gains in the high-conformational-variability regime.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越静态结构:通过DynaReason-Pro将蛋白质动力学与功能关联
arxiv.summaryZh: 蛋白质功能预测普遍依赖序列或单一静态结构，而固有无序蛋白(IDP)的功能由异质构象集合所体现的动力学决定。DynaReason-Pro提出首个从构象集合联合预测GO术语并生成自然语言功能解释的框架，在Protein Ensemble Database(PED)上构建了序列与结构簇均不重叠的IDP基准以防止数据泄漏，并按构象变异性分层评估，显示在高构象变异性区间增益最明显。该工作面向蛋白质功能注释与结构生物学，与LLM/Agent研究交集有限。
arxiv.reason: 蛋白质构象与功能预测，属生物信息学低分方向

arxiv.title: Are We Done with UMLS Injection into Language Models for Medical Question Answering?
arxiv.abstract: Maybe not. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) has become an oracle for millions of clinicians and health system developers worldwide. Researchers have increasingly used knowledge graphs derived from UMLS to enhance language models' factual accuracy and reasoning traceability in high-stakes tasks. Medical Question Answering (MQA) is a prime testbed for integration, with benchmarks usually involving professional exercises such as disease diagnosis and drug prescription from patient history. Despite the assumed benefits, empirical evidence shows that UMLS-based graph injection typically yields modest performance gains. This paper reviews existing MQA work, critically analyzing the selected UMLS sources and their usage with language models, and probes each of these choices in isolation. We uncover methodological issues never discussed in prior work, from low UMLS coverage to weak subgraph retrieval pipelines. Based on our findings, we provide actionable recommendations to unlock the untapped potential of UMLS as an external knowledge source.
arxiv.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables. Code and literature annotations: https://disi-unibo-nlp.github.io/are-we-done-with-umls
arxiv.titleZh: 向语言模型注入UMLS做医学问答，我们已经做完了吗?
arxiv.summaryZh: UMLS派生的知识图谱被广泛注入语言模型以提升医学问答的事实准确性与推理可追溯性，但实测增益普遍有限。工作系统梳理现有MQA文献，把UMLS来源选择、实体链接与子图检索等环节逐项隔离检验。结果暴露出此前未被讨论的方法论缺陷:UMLS对实际问句的覆盖率偏低、子图检索管线薄弱，这些才是增益受限的主因。据此给出可操作改进建议，对知识图谱增强与医学RAG的工程实践有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: 医学问答的UMLS知识注入分析，属LLM垂直应用，方向擦边

arxiv.title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.
arxiv.titleZh: MTA-Zero:通过在线 QA-Solver 协同训练实现自我改进的多模态深度搜索
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态深度搜索依赖人工构建并筛选的固定离线语料，问题分布无法随智能体能力提升而同步演化。MTA-Zero 从图像 VQA 种子上下文出发，用可训练的 QA 生成器在线检索证据、构造并验证多跳问题，由独立的深度搜索 Solver 选择工具、收集证据并作答;再依据 Solver 分组 rollout 的成功率导出 Goldilocks 奖励，全对或全错的问题得零奖励，只保留处于学习前沿的题目，两个策略以 GRPO 各自独立优化、不共享参数与梯度。在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，该方法把 Qwen3-VL-8B Solver 的平均准确率从 36.91% 提升到 51.58%，在同一 agent 工作流下接近 GPT-5，并使 Qwen3.6-27B Solver 再提升 10.82 点。这表明经过验证的在线出题能为深度搜索智能体提供随策略自适应的课程，可用于持续自我改进的 Agentic RL 训练。
arxiv.reason: 在线自生成课程 + GRPO 协同训练的多模态深度搜索智能体，直击 Agentic RL

arxiv.title: Unlocking the Specialization Capability of PPG Foundation Models for Wearable Signals through Structured Pruning and Adaptive Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. Through empirical studies on various PPG foundation models, we find that pretrained models often exhibit inherent sparsity and computational redundancy, suggesting that PPG foundation models have learned to activate task-relevant network substructures for different prediction tasks. To preserve this valuable prior knowledge, we propose a structured pruning-and-fine-tuning framework, SPAFT, which regularizes the adaptive fine-tuning process by constraining it to a more relevant and compact parameter space based on parameter importance and structural redundancy. Extensive experiments across four PPG foundation models, five benchmark datasets, and ten downstream tasks demonstrate that SPAFT achieves win rates of 82.8% and 87.5% on regression and classification tasks, respectively. This prune-then-finetune paradigm often enables PPG foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance, laying a promising foundation for the real-world clinical deployment of PPG foundation models and the development of personalized PPG foundation models.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过结构化剪枝与自适应微调解锁PPG基础模型对可穿戴信号的专业化能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对PPG基础模型多依赖医院血氧仪高质量数据预训练、难以适配可穿戴设备稀疏低质信号，且全量微调后仍不稳定优于通用时序模型的问题，通过实证发现预训练模型存在内在稀疏性与计算冗余，即已学会针对不同预测任务激活相关子网络。据此提出SPAFT结构化剪枝与微调框架，依据参数重要性与结构冗余将自适应微调约束在更紧凑、更相关的参数空间中，以保留预训练先验。在4个PPG基础模型、5个基准数据集、10个下游任务上，回归与分类任务的胜率分别达82.8%与87.5%，剪枝后再微调常使PPG基础模型达到当前最优性能。
arxiv.reason: PPG生理信号基础模型的剪枝微调，与LLM关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Greedy Orthogonal Polynomial Manifolds with Lipschitz Control for Dimensionality Reduction and Reduced Modeling
arxiv.abstract: Polynomial manifolds provide nonlinear low-dimensional representations through polynomial decoders. We propose to represent the polynomial terms of the decoder using features that are orthonormal on the training data. This empirical orthogonality enables a greedy algorithm, Greedy-OPM, which jointly selects encoder modes and polynomial features while minimizing the reconstruction error under a prescribed bound on the decoder's Lipschitz constant. Numerical experiments show that this Lipschitz constraint improves generalization away from the training data while retaining high reconstruction accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 带 Lipschitz 控制的贪心正交多项式流形，用于降维与降阶建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向非线性降维与降阶建模，用训练数据上正交的特征表示多项式解码器的各项，使经验正交性成立，并据此设计贪心算法 Greedy-OPM，在解码器 Lipschitz 常数满足给定上界的前提下联合选择编码器模态与多项式特征、最小化重构误差。数值实验显示，Lipschitz 约束在保持较高重构精度的同时改善了训练数据之外的泛化表现。
arxiv.reason: 经典数值降维与多项式流形方法，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: InfiniteWorld: Separating Visual Evidence from Familiar Physics
arxiv.abstract: Physical reasoning requires adapting familiar expectations to the dynamics of the observed world. Existing benchmarks establish broad physical capabilities, yet an overall score leaves unclear whether answers follow visual evidence when familiar rules no longer apply. We introduce InfiniteWorld, a benchmark that pairs physical-reasoning questions with simulator videos whose physical parameters are systematically altered. Its generation pipeline connects simulation, scene screening, paired video translation, question construction, and input checks. Five tasks assess law identification, parameter estimation, temporal reasoning, analytic counterfactual comparison, and law induction. The evaluation defines five matched input settings for each question, comprising text-only evaluation and ordered or shuffled observations from simulator and translated videos. We evaluate a diverse set of video-language models under these matched settings. The results expose a persistent preference for familiar physical rules. Frames improve performance for most models, but gains differ across tasks. Strong accuracy on Earth-normal questions coexists with poor recognition of altered dynamics, and Earth-normal answers remain common when the observed physics changes. Task scores and semantic agreement further distinguish matching physical factors from matching their amount, and correct answers from repeated errors. InfiniteWorld makes these behaviors measurable through paired changes in the evidence supplied for the same question, separating visual evidence from familiar physics.
arxiv.titleZh: InfiniteWorld：分离视觉证据与熟悉物理规律
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有物理推理基准只看总分、无法判断模型是否依据视觉证据作答的问题，构建 InfiniteWorld：将物理问题与系统改变物理参数的模拟器视频配对，经仿真、场景筛选、成对视频转换、问题构造与输入校验流程生成，覆盖规律识别、参数估计、时序推理、解析反事实比较与规律归纳五类任务，并为每题设置纯文本、模拟器视频有序/乱序、转换视频有序/乱序五种匹配输入。评测多种视频语言模型发现，模型普遍偏好熟悉的物理规律：加入视频帧对多数模型有提升但幅度因任务而异，地球常规问题准确率高而对改变动力学的识别很差，且观测到的物理规律改变后仍常给出地球常规答案。
arxiv.reason: 物理推理基准，涉及视频语言模型评测，与LLM评测方法学仅部分相关

arxiv.title: TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.
arxiv.titleZh: TriageRAG：面向专用领域适配检索增强语言模型的失败感知自训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 专用领域适配RAG常只有无标注语料，SimRAG类方法自造问答对、经往返一致性过滤后统一微调，不区分学生已会、已解还是失败，也不区分失败源于读者还是检索器。TriageRAG在有无检索上下文下探测每个自造问题，将其分为已知、已解、上下文失败、检索失败四类并分派对应训练信号，其中参数化路径教模型在检索缺失时凭参数作答；每轮重探测让训练配比跟随学生，分类直方图兼作无标签诊断。在Qwen3-4B的11个跨三领域数据集与Qwen3-8B的CS-Bench上，比同预算SimRAG高1.2–6.4分，且在检索损害基座的场景均恢复闭卷水平；消融归因于往返过滤剔除了缺少证据的上下文，使学生过度信任噪声检索。
arxiv.reason: RAG领域自训练，按失败类型分派训练信号，属后训练数据侧扎实工作

arxiv.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner's checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.
arxiv.titleZh: System 1 模型漫游指南：超越 LLM 的快速决策
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 逐 token 自回归推理在路由、门控、打分、分类等高频决策上延迟高、成本大、校准差的问题，系统梳理「System 1 决策模型」——单次前向即输出结构化决策的架构。提出五类分类体系（编码器分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比式决策模型、抽取模型），逐类剖析架构、训练方法与部署权衡，并以校准为核心展开 proper scoring rules 理论、RLCD 分析及 IIA 违背、序数尺度偏差、分布漂移下的少样本重校准等现象。进一步给出其在 Agentic 工作流中作为决策基础设施、以及按校准置信度在快慢模型间路由的 System 1 + System 2 级联方案，覆盖 18 个应用域、190 篇参考文献，并附可运行代码、模型库与自查清单。
arxiv.reason: 系统梳理快速决策小模型与 LLM 级联，涉 Agent 基础设施与校准，综述分量足

arxiv.title: An actively trained neural operator for near-explicit atmospheric chemistry
arxiv.abstract: Earth-system models simplify atmospheric chemistry into condensed mechanisms, because near-explicit mechanisms such as the Master Chemical Mechanism (MCM) are too costly to solve in every grid cell. Neural emulators could lift this limit, but most advance the chemistry in small time steps and cover only a few species or a reduced mechanism.
