Here we introduce FNO-MoE, a Fourier neural operator with a mixture of experts that predicts the full near-explicit chemical state over 30 minutes in a single call. The same network also guides its own training, using the disagreement among its experts to select the most informative box-model simulations. At equal cost, this active sampling yields a more accurate emulator than random or evenly spread sampling. Fine-tuning on longer trajectories keeps it stable over multi-hour runs in which models trained on short simulations diverge. The resulting emulator reproduces the evolution of thousands of species with high fidelity, remains accurate for unseen chemical compositions and runs orders of magnitude faster than the numerical solver. These results open a new direction for emulating complex atmospheric systems: neural operators that predict the full chemical state over long windows and choose their own training data. Training under changing meteorology is the next step towards bringing near-explicit chemistry into Earth-system models.
arxiv.titleZh: 一个主动训练的神经算子，用于近显式大气化学
arxiv.summaryZh: 近显式大气化学机制(如MCM)在网格化地球系统模型中求解代价过高，只能简化为凝练机制。FNO-MoE将傅里叶神经算子与专家混合结合，单次调用即可预测未来30分钟的完整近显式化学状态，并利用专家间分歧主动挑选信息量最大的箱模型模拟来指导自身训练。同等成本下，该主动采样训练的模拟器精度优于随机或均匀采样，经长轨迹微调后可在数小时积分中保持稳定，而仅在短模拟上训练的模型会发散。模拟器能高保真复现数千种物种的演化，对未见化学组分仍然准确，速度比数值求解器快数个数量级。
arxiv.reason: 神经算子+MoE方法有新意，但属大气化学垂直应用

arxiv.title: CFL-aware edge design for graph neural solvers of hyperbolic transport
arxiv.abstract: Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that are challenging to capture numerically. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer learned update rules, but neighbor aggregation alone does not tell a GNN how far information must travel and along which edge. As a result, when a GNN model takes a time step larger than what was used in training, shock fronts smear and oscillations grow. In this work, we ask whether making the scale of transport explicit as an edge-local Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) signal can enhance GNNs' ability to model hyperbolic PDEs. Holding the architecture fixed, we vary only the information given to each edge, from a raw edge form to forms that progressively expose the edge-local transport interaction through direction, length, and wave speed. Because all of these are computed from the same ingredients, what changes is not the amount of information but its form. The results show a consistent pattern, in which feature count is not the limiting factor, and appending CFL directly to a raw edge form produces almost no benefit. The CFL conditioning proves most effective when the edge information already exposes the transport interaction, reducing final-step error by 10.4-14.4%, and the improvement widens as the step size grows larger. Notably, this improvement arises not from smearing the solution but from suppressing oscillations near shocks. These results point to a specific design principle that CFL conditioning is most effective when the edge representation already separates the direction of interaction from spatial scale, so that the CFL value has a well-defined quantity to modulate.
arxiv.titleZh: CFL 感知的边设计：面向双曲输运方程的图神经求解器
arxiv.summaryZh: 双曲型 PDE 沿特征线以有限速度传播信息，易产生激波与间断，图神经网络仅靠邻居聚合无法表达信息沿哪条边、传播多远，导致推理步长大于训练步长时激波面模糊、振荡放大。工作固定网络架构，只改变送入每条边的信息形式，从原始边形式逐步显式引入方向、长度与波速所构成的边局部 CFL 输运交互。结果显示特征数量并非瓶颈，直接把 CFL 拼到原始边上几乎无收益；当边表示已分离方向与空间尺度时，CFL 条件化使末步误差降低 10.4%–14.4%，且步长越大增益越明显，其机制是抑制激波附近的振荡而非抹平解。该结论给出了一条具体设计原则：CFL 信号只有在边表示已显式暴露输运交互时才有明确定义的调制对象。
arxiv.reason: 科学计算中 GNN 求解双曲 PDE，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Local Entropy Fluctuations for Black-Box LLM-Generated Text Detection
arxiv.abstract: Zero-shot detection of machine-generated text is vital for mitigating the risks of large language models (LLMs) misuse. While the state-of-the-art dual-model detectors and resampling-based detectors outperform single-model statistical detectors on unprompted continuations, they suffer a catastrophic breakdown on instruction-conditioned text in the black-box setting, where the source model is unknown. We analyze this failure and trace it to poor prompt conditioning for resampling-based methods and diminished cross-model discrepancy for dual-model detectors. Motivated by recent studies that human writing maintains a steady, uniform information flow, whereas machine-generated text exhibits sharp, localized entropy fluctuations, we propose a new metric, the Relative Peak Prominence Rate (RelPPR) to capture this structural contrast along the entropy trajectory and further leverage it as a signal for LLM-generated text detection. Extensive evaluations across diverse model families and datasets demonstrate that RelPPR achieves state-of-the-art black-box detection performance and remains the most reliable detector under various practical situations. Our code is available at https://github.com/brushing-git/entropy-llm-detector.
arxiv.titleZh: 局部熵波动用于黑盒 LLM 生成文本检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 零样本文本检测要在源模型未知的黑盒设定下判别机器生成文本，而现有双模型检测器与重采样检测器在无提示续写任务上表现好，一旦面对指令条件下的文本就会严重失效：重采样法的提示条件化不足，双模型法的跨模型差异被削弱。受「人类写作信息流平稳均匀、机器文本熵轨迹出现尖锐局部波动」这一观察启发，提出相对峰显著率 RelPPR，沿熵轨迹刻画这种结构性差异并用作检测信号。在多个模型族与数据集上的评测显示，该方法取得黑盒检测的当前最优性能，并在多种实际场景中保持最稳定表现。
arxiv.reason: LLM 生成文本检测新指标，属评测方法学擦边，非后训练核心

arxiv.title: StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue
arxiv.abstract: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe's cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.
arxiv.titleZh: StateWise：教语言模型在多轮对话中追踪并遵守不断变化的约束
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮对话中约束会不断被追加、修改和撤回，指令微调模型存在两类失败：约束随轮次累积而失效（persistence failure），已撤回的约束仍被执行（relapse）。StateWise 让单个 LLM 自行维护可修订的类型化约束状态，其中包含标记已撤销约束的墓碑（tombstone）；它先用对话摘要与状态条件响应两类监督微调，再用通过精确往返校验的自生成轨迹自训练，并针对复发对比加入偏好学习阶段。在 Llama-3.1-8B 等两个 7–8B 骨架上，以留出约束族和未见表述测试，相比监督自训练复发率降低 8–22 点，对话成功率提升 8–19 点，且在无推理期外部脚手架时复发指标优于 oracle 编译台账基线。
arxiv.reason: 多轮对话约束状态维护与自改进训练，属后训练与 Agent 记忆方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition
arxiv.abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. The streaming student is fine-tuned on the mixture in a single pass. Across customer-service calls with gold roles and earnings calls with silver roles, RoleHear attributes roles accurately while preserving transcription quality and narrowing the gap to the offline teacher.
arxiv.titleZh: RoleHear：面向半监督角色属性流式语音识别的伪标签方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 流式ASR低延迟但只输出无角色归属的词流，而客服分析等实时场景需要把每个词绑定到说话角色，且角色标注训练数据稀缺。RoleHear让单个cache-aware流式transducer通过词表内的角色token内联输出角色：先给出快速话轮边界标记，几个词后再给出对应角色token；再用微调为角色属性识别器的离线transducer教师对无标注音频重打标签，并在缺少金标处由多模态大语言模型提供银标角色标签，流式学生模型单遍混合数据微调。在带金标角色的客服通话与带银标的财报电话会议上，方法在保持转写质量的同时准确归属角色，并缩小了与离线教师的差距。
arxiv.reason: 语音识别角色归属，属语音应用，仅与LLM弱相关

arxiv.title: All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to combine multiple pieces of evidence into decisions that satisfy all relevant constraints. Evaluations centered on final-answer accuracy leave unclear whether failures arise from reading individual facts or using them together. We study this question through the multi-evidence integration gap, linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks. Our evaluation combines conditional performance given correct local answers with same-grid local queries, text-oracle inputs, retrieval controls, and constraint ablations. We further examine hidden-state probes and activation replacement across network depth, token positions, and model families. Across the evaluated models, accurate local recovery coexists with substantial global failure. For example, Gemma-3-27B recovers all evaluated isolated item facts correctly but achieves only 19.75% global validity on eight-item visual instances. Probes decode information about solution membership from global-prompt states, while corresponding clean-state replacement recovers failed decisions over model-dependent depth ranges. These findings show that recovering facts and representing solution-related information are insufficient for reliable joint decisions. They motivate evaluations and model improvements that explicitly target how available evidence is combined, alongside advances in perception and model scale.
arxiv.titleZh: 所有事实都齐全，答案却依然错误:视觉语言模型中的整合缺口
arxiv.summaryZh: 多证据推理要求模型把多条证据组合成同时满足全部约束的决策，而只考核最终答案的评测无法区分失败源于读不出单个事实，还是无法把它们联合使用。工作以受控的子集选择与路径搜索任务定义「多证据整合缺口」，用局部同格子查询、文本 oracle 输入、检索控制与约束消融，并结合跨网络深度、token 位置与模型族的隐状态探针和激活替换加以刻画。Gemma-3-27B 在八项视觉实例上能正确恢复全部孤立条目事实，全局有效率却仅 19.75%;全局提示状态下探针可解码出解集归属信息，对应的干净状态替换能在与模型相关的深度区间内修复失败决策。结论是事实恢复与解集信息表征并不足以支撑可靠联合决策，评测与模型改进需显式针对证据组合方式。
arxiv.reason: MLLM 多证据推理的诊断性评测与机制分析，贴近理解侧与评测方法学

arxiv.title: Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems
arxiv.abstract: As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. RATE provides a streamlined error taxonomy, expanded severity ratings, and multidimensional scoring balancing accuracy and fluency, facilitating deeper analysis of MT outputs. Our analysis, powered by this expert dataset, reveals that state-of-the-art MT systems may have surpassed human translations in accuracy while still lagging in fluency - a critical distinction obscured by existing accuracy-biased metrics. Our findings highlight that advancing MT evaluation requires not only better protocols but crucially, high-quality annotations from skilled linguists.
arxiv.comment: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2025. 17 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/wmt24-en-ru-rate
arxiv.titleZh: 面向翻译评估的精炼评估体系：在人机同水平时代重思机器翻译评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向接近人类水平的机器翻译系统，传统评估方法难以捕捉细微错误；工作系统梳理了MQM与ESA等金标准做法在标注者水平不一、错误分类过繁、严重度粒度过粗、偏重准确度而轻视流畅度以及时间压力等方面的局限。为此构建了WMT24英俄方向的专业语言学家人工评估数据集，并提出RATE协议：精简错误分类体系、扩展严重度等级、对准确度与流畅度做多维打分。基于该专家数据发现，当前最强机器翻译系统在准确度上可能已超过人工译文，但流畅度仍落后，而这一差异被现有偏准确度的指标掩盖；结论是评估进步不仅依赖协议设计，更依赖高水平语言学家的高质量标注。
arxiv.reason: 翻译评估协议与数据集，属评测方法学但偏MT专用

arxiv.title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 1 figure. Dataset and prompts: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/orbit-mt-eval
arxiv.titleZh: 超越提示词：基于 LLM 的机器翻译评估器的系统性研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 系统考察指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型选择与多步工作流如何影响 span 级与排序式机器翻译评估。作者在 WMT24/WMT25 英俄翻译上收集新的专家 RATE 标注，并在五个额外语向的 MQM/ESA 基准上做迁移验证，得到四点结论：指令结构塑造评估器行为；高质量示例比数量更重要；不同前沿骨干呈现召回型、精确型或排序型等不同评估画像；多骨干输出融合优于单评估器多次调用。据此提出 ORBIT 评估器系列，最强配置在错误 span 检测与 Accuracy/Fluency 排序上达到专家水平，成本约为人工标注的 1/20。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 评估方法学扎实，但属评估侧增量改进

arxiv.title: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
arxiv.abstract: In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. Furthermore, when the target distribution itself depends on the model being optimized, we show that the accumulation of estimation variance can induce a deterministic degradation of the target distribution. These results provide a theoretical explanation, at least in part, for the long-term behavior of existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. With this intuition we further designed Conditional KL (CKL) regularization for mitigating the degradation of the target distribution. CKL can effectively preserve mode diversity while relaxing the constraint imposed by classical KL regularization on reward improvements. We believe this theoretical perspective can bring some new understanding of language model training algorithms and provide useful guidance for future research.
arxiv.titleZh: 从分布匹配视角看 LLM 训练算法
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出一个统一框架，把 LLM 各阶段(预训练、蒸馏、RL 后训练)的训练算法都解释为最小化当前模型与某个目标分布之间的某种散度，并指出刻画目标分布的性质就能推断算法的行为。分析表明:当前模型分布与目标分布接近时，On-Policy Distillation(OPD)优于经典 Knowledge Distillation(KD)，两者相距较远时则相反;当目标分布本身依赖待优化模型时，估计方差的累积会导致目标分布发生确定性退化，这为现有 RL 算法的长期行为提供了部分理论解释。基于该直觉设计 Conditional KL(CKL)正则，在放宽经典 KL 对奖励提升的约束的同时保持模式多样性。
arxiv.reason: 统一分布匹配视角解读蒸馏与 RL 后训练，直击后训练方向
